text:
deploy-bot: preflight-eval-gate report -> summarizer service v2.3 shows regression on prompt-suite A. metric: avg_rouge_drop=0.063 (threshold=0.05). Blocking promotion. details: https://ci.internal/runs/4823 :rotating_light:

marta: saw the alert, grabbing the failing examples now.

jamal: quick note — I ran a local quantized run and observed formatting shifts around list bullets. looks like a tokenization/quantization interaction, not model semantics yet. will post diff.

oliver: is the delta concentrated on specific prompts or across the board? we need to decide pin vs rollback.

kevin-qa: ran a smaller gold set, results: 12/200 prompts failed (mostly hallucination/body truncation). sample failures:
```
- prompt_id: 1142 -> expected mention of X, output omitted.
- prompt_id: 1177 -> added unrelated fact.
```

marta: proposal: don't rollback cluster-wide. pin production route to v2.2, hold v2.3 in canary at 5% and collect extended evals. shift release window by 48h. I'll open the PR to pin routing.

ana: +1 on pin. we should also add a short note in release notes and notify enterprise customers with active SLAs.

jamal: agree with pin. follow-ups: (1) run evals with KV cache disabled, (2) run with float32 sampling to rule out quant noise. I'll queue both.

oliver: approving the pin. @release-manager can you execute the route pin and update the runbook (include the `preflight-eval` artifact link)? :white_check_mark:

release-manager: on it. pinning summarizer-prod -> v2.2 now; canary remains v2.3 at 5% traffic. ETA ~12m. creating incident note and brief customer blurb.

deploy-bot: routing update: summarizer-prod pinned to v2.2 by release-manager at 1738457900. canary traffic to v2.3 = 5%. eval-gate status -> pending re-run (artifact id: art-4823).

marta: thanks. I'll draft an internal postmortem stub once we see the re-run. threshold for postmortem: regression > 0.05.

kevin-qa: expanding eval suite now (2000 prompts). will attach artifacts to the PR and add a short triage doc with failing clusters. ETA ~2h.

ana: decision log for this thread -> ACTIONS: [pin prod to v2.2, hold v2.3 canary at 5%, run extended evals w/ and w/o KV cache, update release notes & notify reps]. Re-eval window = 24h; if extended eval passes, we can unpin; if not, plan rollback to v2.1 nightly and schedule hotfix.

jamal: adding one more thing — annotate the eval suite with the exact metric diff and provide seed/config used so we can reproduce deterministically.

release-manager: updated runbook and release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/summarizer/notes/draft-1738456789. sending initial customer note to account reps. will follow up after QA artifacts.

marta: closing for now. thanks everyone — we can reconvene if QA surfaces different failure modes. :thumbsup:
